roadmap.home.title: Roadmap
roadmap.landing.title: Any goal, as a skill tree
roadmap.landing.sub: Redecorating a room, learning to bake, training for a 10k, or planning a side project — Windmill turns any plan into a living tree. Finish one step and watch the next branch unlock.
roadmap.landing.seatNote: Signing out keeps your trees on this device.
roadmap.landing.howSub: That’s the whole loop. The tree keeps score, so you never wonder what’s next.
roadmap.landing.beatPlantCopy: Plant steps by hand — your plan arrives as a tree. Starter quests and paste-a-list are growing in.
roadmap.landing.beatFinishCopy: Mark it done and the fruit ripens — progress you can see from across the room.
roadmap.landing.beatUnlockCopy: Light travels the branch. Whatever depended on that step wakes up, ready for you.
roadmap.landing.pathsSub: Authored learning trees with real prerequisite logic — ownership gates lifetimes, fundamentals gate frameworks. Pick one and it’s yours to grow.
roadmap.landing.aiTitle: Your agent tends the tree with you
roadmap.landing.aiSub: Claude, Cursor, or Codex can create and update your roadmaps. Pick your tool, paste one snippet — your browser handles the rest.
roadmap.landing.aiPromise: First connect opens your browser to approve — no keys to paste.
roadmap.landing.aiCant: It can’t share roadmaps, delete them, or see your chats.
roadmap.landing.storyTitle: Made to share, and to sync
roadmap.landing.storyShareCopy: Every tree is a page. Send the link — anyone can fork a copy and grow their own.
roadmap.landing.storySyncCopy: Sign in once and your trees follow — check a step off on your phone, edit the branches at your desk.
roadmap.landing.ctaSub: It takes about a minute, and the first branch unlocks tonight.
roadmap.head.title: Windmill Roadmap — any goal, as a skill tree
roadmap.head.description: Turn any goal or learning roadmap into an animated RPG skill tree. Finish a step, unlock the next branch. Free, no account — plant your first tree.
roadmap.head.socialTitle: Windmill — Any goal, as a skill tree
roadmap.head.ogDescription: Turn any plan — redecorating a room, learning to bake, training for a 10k, shipping a side project — into a living RPG skill tree. Finish a step, watch the next branch unlock. Public beta, no account needed.
roadmap.head.twitterDescription: Turn any plan into a living RPG skill tree. Finish a step, watch the next branch unlock. Public beta — no account needed, your first tree lives in your browser.
roadmap.head.imageAlt: A hand-drawn RPG skill tree on a cream background with terracotta, gold, and sky nodes, the Windmill wordmark, and the tagline “Any goal, as a skill tree.”
roadmap.head.fallbackHow: How it works: Map your plan → Finish a step → Watch it unlock.
roadmap.head.schemaDescription: Windmill renders any roadmap or goal as an animated RPG skill tree. Map your plan, finish a step to ripen its fruit, and watch dependent branches light up. No account needed — your first tree lives in your browser — and every tree is a shareable, forkable page.
roadmap.head.schemaBrowserRequirements: Requires a browser with WebGL2 support
roadmap.head.featureTree: Turn any plan into a living RPG skill tree with real prerequisite logic
roadmap.head.featureNoAccount: No account needed — your first tree lives in your browser
roadmap.head.featureShare: Share any tree as a page; anyone can fork a copy and grow their own
roadmap.head.featureMcp: Speaks MCP so Claude, Cursor, or any agent can create and update a tree
roadmap.head.featureSync: Sign in once and your trees sync across phone and desktop
roadmap.head.featureQuests: Nine authored starter quests; three of the developer paths adapted from roadmap.sh (CC BY-SA)
roadmap.head.offerDescription: All of Windmill, free: as many trees as you like, up to 10,000 steps in each, private trees, the whole editor, paste import, sharing, forking, export, and the MCP server with an API key. Roadmap AI assistance is being redesigned. Its allowance is not announced yet.
